category_title: Students with moderate to severe cognitive impairments who exhibit withdrawal or off-task behaviors in inclusive settings while thriving in self-contained environments
scenario_title: Recorder playing and music reading in inclusive setting
minimal_context: Katie is in a fourth-grade inclusive music class attempting to read music notation and play the recorder.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at the music notation on the board and play the next song on our recorders. Remember to use your fingers to cover the holes.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Katie holds the recorder to her mouth but does not cover any of the holes with her fingers. She blows into it inaccurately.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Katie, try to follow along with the notes and play with the rest of the class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Katie stops trying to play. She becomes withdrawn, looking away from the music notation, and starts just playing around with the recorder in her hands.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please stop playing with the instrument and try to read the music.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I need a tissue. Can I go to the bathroom? (Katie puts the recorder down on her desk, completely shutting down, and just sits quietly watching the rest of the class.)

task.content: Recorder-playing activities and decoding music notation
task.learning_goal: Use fine motor coordination to cover holes on a recorder or use the tongue to control articulation, and decode music notation

context.social_setting: Inclusive setting with peers sitting next to the student

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When activities common in fourth-grade music were far out of reach for Katie in terms of physical and cognitive ability
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Withdrawn and off-task, engaged in behavior such as playing with her recorder, asking for tissues, and trips to the bathroom
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Seems to just need to shut down, but she is still watching. She just absorbs

behavior_patterns.condition: Attempting to play the recorder despite lack of prerequisite skills
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Frequently off-task, and that even when she 'played,' she was clearly not accurate in her fingerings, or even covering any holes
